scripts.tui: npm run stage:tui-core && bun run tui/src/main.ts
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); for (const p of ['core/dist', 'vscode/out', 'vscode/media/webview']) fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.lint: oxlint core/src core/test vscode/src vscode/test test-support vscode/webview/apps vscode/webview/shared vscode/webview/*.ts tui/src tui/test scripts .github/scripts .vscode-test.mjs playwright.config.mjs commitlint.config.ts oxfmt.config.ts oxlint.config.ts
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix core/src core/test vscode/src vscode/test test-support vscode/webview/apps vscode/webview/shared vscode/webview/*.ts tui/src tui/test scripts .github/scripts .vscode-test.mjs playwright.config.mjs commitlint.config.ts oxfmt.config.ts oxlint.config.ts
scripts.format: oxfmt --config ./oxfmt.config.ts --check core/src core/test core/package.json core/tsconfig.json core/tsconfig.coverage.json vscode/src vscode/test test-support vscode/webview/apps vscode/webview/shared vscode/package.json vscode/tsconfig.json vscode/tsconfig.test.json vscode/webview/tsconfig.json vscode/webview/tsconfig.test.json vscode/webview/*.ts tui/src tui/test tui/package.json tui/tsconfig.json package.json tsconfig.base.json scripts .github/scripts/*.mjs .vscode-test.mjs playwright.config.mjs commitlint.config.ts oxfmt.config.ts oxlint.config.ts
scripts.format:fix: oxfmt --config ./oxfmt.config.ts --write core/src core/test core/package.json core/tsconfig.json core/tsconfig.coverage.json vscode/src vscode/test test-support vscode/webview/apps vscode/webview/shared vscode/package.json vscode/tsconfig.json vscode/tsconfig.test.json vscode/webview/tsconfig.json vscode/webview/tsconfig.test.json vscode/webview/*.ts tui/src tui/test tui/package.json tui/tsconfig.json package.json tsconfig.base.json scripts .github/scripts/*.mjs .vscode-test.mjs playwright.config.mjs commitlint.config.ts oxfmt.config.ts oxlint.config.ts
scripts.clean:test: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); for (const p of ['vscode/out/core/test', 'vscode/out/vscode/test', 'vscode/out/test-support', 'vscode/out/test']) fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.compile:test: npm run compile:core && npm run clean:test && tsc -p vscode/tsconfig.test.json
scripts.compile:webview: npm run compile:webview:crop_pdf && npm run compile:webview:merge_pdf && npm run compile:webview:split_pdf && npm run compile:webview:rotate_pdf && npm run compile:webview:reorder_pdf && npm run compile:webview:preview && npm run compile:webview:table_editor
scripts.test:webview: npm run test:webview:crop_pdf && npm run test:webview:merge_pdf && npm run test:webview:split_pdf && npm run test:webview:rotate_pdf && npm run test:webview:reorder_pdf && npm run test:webview:preview && npm run test:webview:table_editor
scripts.test:webview:coverage: npm run test:webview:crop_pdf -- --coverage && npm run test:webview:merge_pdf -- --coverage && npm run test:webview:split_pdf -- --coverage && npm run test:webview:rotate_pdf -- --coverage && npm run test:webview:reorder_pdf -- --coverage && npm run test:webview:preview -- --coverage && npm run test:webview:table_editor -- --coverage
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run compile && npm run compile:test && npm run compile:webview
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format && npm run typecheck:core && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:test && npm run typecheck:webview && npm run typecheck:webview:test && npm run check:package-boundaries
scripts.test:scripts: npm run compile:test && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && node --experimental-test-module-mocks --test vscode/out/core/test/unit/operations/terminate_process_tree.test.js
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run check:extension-meta && npm run check:nls && npm run check:unused && npm run check:webview-warnings && npm run test:scripts
scripts.check:fix: npm run lint:fix && npm run format:fix
scripts.test:tui: npm run stage:tui-core && bun install --cwd tui --frozen-lockfile && bun run --cwd tui check && bun test --cwd tui
scripts.test:prepackage: npm run build && npm run test:scripts && npm run test:vscode:webview && npm run test:vscode:host
scripts.test:development: npm run test:prepackage && npm run test:tui
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && npm run test:coverage:run
scripts.test:coverage:run: npm run compile:core:coverage && vscode-test --coverage --coverage-output coverage/vscode --coverage-reporter text-summary --coverage-reporter html --coverage-reporter lcov && node scripts/extension-host-coverage.mjs coverage/vscode/lcov.info
scripts.verify:docker: bash scripts/test-in-docker.sh check:all build test:webview test package:vsix test:playwright:smoke
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package:vsix
